DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料理講座のご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the cooking class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。参加したいですが、包丁を使うのが苦手です。初心者でも参加できるか、申し込む前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初心者の包丁不安を伝え申込前に参加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to join, but I am not good at using a kitchen knife. Before applying, I would like to ask whether beginners can participate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about using a knife as a beginner and ask whether you can participate before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 講座の担当へ確認します。どの作業が特にご不安ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the person in charge of the class. Which task are you particularly worried about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 皮をむく時、食材を持つ手が不安です。切る速さより、手の置き方から教わりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 皮むき時の保持手の位置を教わりたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: When peeling, I am unsure about the hand holding the food. Rather than cutting speed, I would like to start by learning where to place my hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to learn where to position the hand holding the food while peeling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当日の進め方や支援の範囲は、担当からご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain how the day will proceed and the extent of support available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 料理の経験が少ないことも伝えてください。見本を見てから、一つずつ取り組みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 経験不足を伝え実演後に一つずつ学ぶことを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please also tell them I have little cooking experience. I would like to watch a demonstration and then work on things one at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your lack of experience and request to learn one task at a time after a demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望を伝えます。ご一緒に申し込む方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that request on. Is anyone applying with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人と参加したいです。ただ、友人は経験があるので、同じ作業についていけるかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 経験ある友人と参加したいが作業進行への不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to attend with a friend. But my friend has experience, so I also want to check whether I can keep up with the same tasks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to attend with an experienced friend but are worried about keeping up with the tasks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に二つのご質問を確認します。回答まで、こちらでお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check those two questions with the person in charge. Could you wait here for a reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。初心者への説明と、友人と一緒に参加する場合の進め方を聞いてから申し込みを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初心者説明と友人との進行回答を待って申込みを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait. I will decide whether to apply after hearing about explanations for beginners and how things would proceed if I attended with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for answers about beginner instruction and how to proceed with your friend before deciding whether to apply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へお問い合わせします。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ask the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: たばこの習慣について、こちらの欄をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check this section about smoking habits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今は吸っていませんが、去年までは吸っていました。「吸わない」だけに丸を付けると、昔のことが伝わりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在非喫煙だが昨年までの習慣も書くべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not smoke now, but I smoked until last year. If I only circle 'do not smoke,' will that fail to convey my past smoking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should also record your smoking habit until last year, although you currently do not smoke. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前吸っていたこともお伝えください。やめた時期は覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please also mention that you used to smoke. Do you remember when you quit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 去年の秋です。日にちは正確ではありませんが、九月ごろから吸っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨年九月ごろ禁煙で正確日不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last autumn. I do not remember the exact date, but I have not smoked since around September.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you quit around September last year and do not know the exact date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 以前は、どのくらいお吸いでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: How much did you used to smoke?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 普段は一日十本くらいでした。忙しい日は少なかったので、おおよその数です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去一日十本程度で日ごとの差もあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Usually around ten cigarettes a day. I smoked less on busy days, so that is an approximate number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you previously smoked about ten cigarettes a day, with variations from day to day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: おおよその量として、そのように伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please report it that way as an approximate amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今のゼロ本と、以前の一日十本ほどを分けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在ゼロと過去概数を分けて書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will write the current zero cigarettes separately from the previous ten or so per day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write the current zero separately from the approximate past number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容を診療担当にもお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also inform the medical staff of those details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 去年の九月ごろにやめ、以前は一日十本くらいと記入しました。この経過を診察でも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 禁煙時期と以前の概数を記入し診察でも説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written that I quit around September last year and previously smoked about ten cigarettes a day. I will also explain this history at my consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have entered when you quit and the approximate past amount, and will explain them at your consultation too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その用紙をお持ちになってお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please hold on to that form while you wait. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 音についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss noise?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨夜、隣の部屋の音が大きくて眠れませんでした。私も壁をたたいてしまったので、そのことも話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜間音不眠と自身の壁叩きも相談で明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Last night, the noise from the next room was so loud I could not sleep. I also knocked on the wall, and I want to mention that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: When consulting, disclose both the nighttime noise that prevented sleep and your own knocking on the wall. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような音が、いつ頃聞こえましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What kind of sound did you hear, and around what time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十一時ごろから低い音が続きました。音楽か機械かまでは、部屋の中から分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十一時から低音だが音源種別未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A low sound continued from around eleven. From inside my room, I cannot tell whether it was music or machinery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that a low sound began at eleven, but the type of source has not been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 壁をたたいたのは、その後ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Was it after that that you knocked on the wall?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、十一時半ごろ一度たたきました。相手と直接話したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十一時半一回叩き直接会話なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I knocked once around eleven thirty. I did not speak directly with the other person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you knocked once at eleven thirty and had no direct conversation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その前後の経過も担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell the person in charge what happened before and after that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 止まるかと思ってたたきましたが、直接話せていません。もう同じことを繰り返さず、相談できる方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己行為を省かず再叩きで解決しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I knocked thinking it might stop, but I have not spoken to them directly. I want to know how to seek advice without repeating the same action.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Include your own action and say you will not try to resolve it by knocking again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今、同じ音は聞こえていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you hear the same sound now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝は聞こえていません。昨日の音が続いた時間と、自分がたたいた時刻を分けて、相談の方法を教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今朝無音と前夜音継続自身行為を時系列で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not heard it this morning. I would like to explain separately how long the noise lasted yesterday and when I knocked, and learn how to seek advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain chronologically that there is no sound this morning, how long last night's sound lasted, and your own action. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、経過を担当が伺います。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will hear the sequence of events. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お出しになる封筒はこちらの二通ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these the two envelopes you want to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一通は私の手紙、もう一通は家族から頼まれた物です。料金を私が払っても、差出人は全部私にするのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二通の料金支払者本人と差出人を同じにすべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. One is my letter, and the other is something my family asked me to send. Even if I pay the postage, should I make myself the sender on both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the person paying for two letters and the named sender must be the same person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 料金を払う方と、差出人の記載は別です。それぞれの送り主を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person paying the postage and the sender listed are separate matters. Please check who sent each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族の方は、家族が書いて封をした物です。私が運んで来ただけで、中の手紙を書いた人ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族便は家族作成封入で本人は運搬のみと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family wrote and sealed the family one. I only brought it here; I am not the person who wrote the letter inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your family wrote and enclosed their letter and you only transported it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そちらの差出人は、封筒に記載されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is the sender written on that envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の名前と住所が書いてあります。この表示で、家族が送り主として出せるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既記載家族氏名住所を自己名へ書換えず出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family member's name and address are written on it. So with those details, I can send it with my family member as the sender.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Send it with the family member's name and address already written, without changing them to your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の手紙の差出人も、お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the sender on your own letter too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは私の名前です。二通の送り先も違うので、封筒を入れ替えていないか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人便氏名と異なる二宛先の取り違えを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one has my name. The two destinations are different too, so I will check that the envelopes have not been switched.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your name on your own letter and for mix-ups between the two different recipients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お支払いは、まとめてご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can arrange payment for both together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。料金は二通まとめて私が払いますが、差出人と宛先はそれぞれの封筒で確認してお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払まとめと各差出宛先を分け二通を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will pay the postage for both together, but check the sender and recipient on each envelope before handing them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the combined payment separate from each sender and recipient, and hand over the two letters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二通をお預かりします。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take both letters now. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの現金をお預けでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to deposit this cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。旅行の後で円と外国の紙幣を同じ封筒に入れてしまいました。分けてから出したいのですが、この台を使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混在する円外国紙幣を分ける作業台の使用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. After a trip, I put yen and foreign banknotes in the same envelope. I would like to sort them before handing them over. May I use this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to use a work surface to separate mixed yen and foreign banknotes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どうぞお使いください。円のお預けと外国のお金のご相談は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please go ahead. We will check yen deposits and inquiries about foreign money separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二枚は旅行先の紙幣です。今日は両替せず、持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外国紙幣二枚は両替せず持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two notes are from my travel destination. I will take them home without exchanging them today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the two foreign banknotes home without exchanging them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 円の分は、いくらお預けになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: How much yen would you like to deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 千円札三枚で三千円です。外国の紙幣にも千と書いてあるので、封筒のメモは混ぜて足してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 円三千と外国の千表示を混ぜたメモの誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three 1,000-yen notes, totaling 3,000 yen. The foreign notes also say one thousand, so I mistakenly added them together in the note on the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the error in the note that mixed 3,000 yen with the foreign notes marked one thousand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お預けになる円の額を、改めてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the yen amount you will deposit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 円の三枚を数え直しました。こちらの金額欄は三千円と書き直してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 円三枚を数え直し金額欄の記入方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I recounted the three yen notes. May I correct this amount field to 3,000 yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Recount the three yen notes and ask how to fill in the amount field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの用紙には、ご希望の三千円をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please enter your intended deposit of 3,000 yen on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。外国の二枚は財布の別のポケットにしまい、円の三枚とこの用紙をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外国紙幣を別保管し円三枚と三千円用紙を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written it. I will put the two foreign notes in a separate pocket of my wallet and give you the three yen notes and this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Store the foreign notes separately and hand over three yen notes with the 3,000-yen form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、三千円のお預けとして確認いたします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check this as a deposit of 3,000 yen. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お豆腐をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人分ずつ使いたいです。この二個入りは、片方を開けたらもう片方も開く包みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二容器の片方開封で両方開くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to use one serving at a time. With this two-pack, does opening one also open the other?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether opening one of two containers opens both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの容器に、別のふたが付いています。外側の包みとは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Each container has its own lid. Those are separate from the outer wrapping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別々に開けられるのですね。それなら、小さい容器二つの物を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 独立して開封できる小容器二つの商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So they can be opened separately. In that case, I would like the product with two small containers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a product with two small containers that can be opened independently. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容量はこちらに載っています。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一個百五十グラムで、二つ合わせて三百グラムですね。一食に一個使えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一個百五十と合計三百の内容量を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Each is 150 grams, so the two together are 300 grams. I could use one for each meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish between the 150 grams per container and the 300-gram total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保存についても、表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the storage instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保存の表示はここですね。帰宅したら、この表示に合わせて冷蔵庫へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存表示を読み帰宅後の冷蔵保存を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The storage instructions are here. When I get home, I will put it in the refrigerator according to these instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the storage instructions and confirm refrigeration after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would this product be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は一個ずつの量で使えるこの二個入りにします。買ってから、外の包みと各容器のふたを分けて扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 独立量の商品を選び外包装と各蓋を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I will choose this two-pack that lets me use one container's worth at a time. After buying it, I will handle the outer wrapping and each container's lid separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the product with individual portions and distinguish the outer wrapping from each lid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お会計へどうぞ。ご利用ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed to checkout. Thank you for shopping with us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 羽根がベンチの方へ飛んでいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The shuttlecock is flying toward the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。打つたびに人が座っている所へ飛んでしまいます。遊ぶ向きを変えた方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベンチへ繰返し飛ぶ羽根で打つ向き変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sorry. Every time I hit it, it flies toward where people are sitting. Should I change the direction we are playing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about changing your hitting direction because the shuttlecock repeatedly flies toward the bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人のいる場所へ飛ばないよう、場所と向きを見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please reconsider the location and direction so that it does not fly toward people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は友人とベンチに向かって打っています。横を向けば、飛ぶ先が変わりますが、通路もないか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチ向きから横向きにし通路有無も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Right now, my friend and I are hitting toward the bench. If we turn sideways, it will fly in a different direction, but I will check whether there is a walkway too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Turn sideways from facing the bench and also check for a walkway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通行する方がいる所へも飛ばさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not send it toward places where people are walking either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 空いた所を見つけました。遠くへ強く飛ばすのでなく、友人と短い距離で打ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人へ飛ばさず空所で友人と短距離を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have found an open space. Rather than hitting it hard over a long distance, I would like to play with my friend at a short distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to play at a short distance with your friend in an open area without sending it toward people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 落ちた羽根を取りに行く時も、周囲にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please watch your surroundings when retrieving a fallen shuttlecock too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチの下へ転がった時は、座っている方の足元へ急に手を入れず、先に声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 足元回収は急に手を入れず先に声掛けする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it rolls under the bench, I will speak to the seated person first, rather than suddenly reaching toward their feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: When retrieving it near someone's feet, speak to them first instead of suddenly reaching in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please be considerate in that way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人と向きを変えました。人が近づいたら打つのを止め、通り過ぎてから続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 向きを変え人が来た時中断して再開する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend and I have changed direction. If someone approaches, we will stop hitting and resume after they have passed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Change direction, pause when people come, and resume afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、周囲を見ながらお楽しみください。ご協力ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy yourselves while keeping an eye on your surroundings. Thank you for your cooperation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行の案内をご確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the service information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 放送の音が聞き取りにくく、列車が遅れていることしか分かりませんでした。今の案内を文字で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延放送を聞き取れず文字の案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The announcement was hard to hear, and I only understood that the train was delayed. I would like to see the current information in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you could not make out the delay announcement and request written information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの運行掲示でご案内します。どちらへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can explain using this service notice. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先はこの地図の駅の近くです。この駅まで乗りたいのですが、まだ時刻表だけを見て待っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的駅と時刻表だけで待っていた状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My workplace is near the station on this map. I want to travel to this station, but I have been waiting while looking only at the timetable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your destination station and that you had been waiting based only on the timetable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この掲示では、列車の運転を見合わせています。再開の時刻はまだ掲示されていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This notice says train services are suspended. A resumption time has not been posted yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 運転を見合わせていて、再開の時刻もまだ出ていないのですね。会社には到着を決めず、遅れがあることを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再開時刻未定を理解し会社へ到着時刻を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So services are suspended, and no resumption time has been announced yet. I will tell my company there is a delay without giving a definite arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the resumption time is undetermined and avoid giving your company a definite arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の移動をご検討の場合も、先に運行や利用条件をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you consider another way to travel, please check its service status and conditions of use first too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。友人が別の路線を提案しましたが、乗り換え先まで行けるか確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人提案の代替路線の到達条件を先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me with that. A friend suggested another line, but I want to check whether I can reach the transfer point before choosing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: First check the conditions for reaching the transfer point on the alternative line your friend suggested. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を案内の担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will connect you with the information staff about that request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。放送が聞こえない時は黙って待つだけにせず、掲示と担当の説明で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 掲示と担当説明で情報を確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. When I cannot hear an announcement, I will not just wait silently, but check the notice and the staff's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will verify the information using notices and staff explanations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご案内します。移動の際はお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the staff member. Please be careful when moving around.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 子育ての窓口をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the child-rearing support counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来月から仕事の終わる時間が遅くなります。小学生の子どもが放課後に過ごす場所を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 終業時間変更に備え小学生の放課後の居場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: From next month, my work will finish later. I would like to discuss a place for my elementary school child to spend time after school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a place for an elementary school child after school in preparation for a change in your work finishing time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。お子様の学年と学校は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge. Can you tell me your child's grade and school?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一年生で、学校名はこちらに書きました。今は帰宅に間に合いますが、来月は五時まで働きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一年生の学校と来月からの五時終業を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: First grade, and I wrote the school name here. Currently I get home in time for my child, but from next month I will work until five.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your first grader's school and that your work will finish at five from next month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用条件や空き状況は、担当が確認します。毎日のご利用を考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check eligibility and availability. Are you considering using it every day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 月曜から金曜です。土日は家にいます。残業のある日だけでなく、平日の予定として相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 平日の毎日利用を考え土日は不要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Monday through Friday. I am at home on Saturdays and Sundays. I want to discuss it as my weekday schedule, not just for days with overtime.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are considering use every weekday and do not need weekends. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その予定をお伝えください。必要な書類も担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them that schedule. The person in charge will also explain the necessary documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勤務先からどんな書類をもらうか、説明を聞いてから頼みたいです。今日はメモだけ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先へ頼む書類の説明を先に聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to hear which documents I should get from my employer before requesting them. Today I have brought only my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to hear an explanation of the documents before asking your employer for them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メモでも相談を始められます。今日、利用が決まるという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can begin the consultation with notes. That does not mean use will be approved today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。学年、学校、平日の終業時刻を伝え、申込みの時期と書類を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談内容を整理し申込時期と必要書類を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will tell them the grade, school, and weekday work finishing time, and check when to apply and which documents are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the consultation details and check the application timing and required documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの担当へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please see this staff member. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入院のお荷物を確認します。ほかに持参された物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will check your belongings for admission. Have you brought anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で寝る時に使う呼吸の機器を持ってきました。病室でも使うことについて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭用の呼吸機器を持参し病棟での使用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought the breathing device I use when sleeping at home. I would like to discuss using it in the hospital room too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you brought your home breathing device and discuss using it on the ward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。いつも使っている機器と分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Do you have documents showing that this is the device you normally use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この説明書と通院先でもらった紙です。設定を変えずに持ってきましたが、まだ電源は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 説明書と通院資料を示し未通電と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This manual and a paper I received from my usual clinic. I brought it without changing the settings, but have not turned it on yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the manual and clinic document and say that the device has not been powered on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使用の可否や接続は、病棟の担当が確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The ward staff will check whether it can be used and how to connect it before giving instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。コンセントが空いていたので、家族が先に差そうとしています。確認まで待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族にも接続を待ってもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. My family saw an available outlet and is about to plug it in first. I will ask them to wait until it has been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will also have your family wait before connecting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機器の付属品も一緒に置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the device's accessories with it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: マスクと管、電源のコードがあります。普段の物をそろえて、この袋のまま担当へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: マスク管コードを機器とまとめて担当へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the mask, tube, and power cord. I will gather my usual equipment and show it to the person in charge in this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Gather the mask, tube, and cord with the device and show them to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: いつもお使いになる時間も、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us when you normally use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 毎晩、寝る時です。今夜使えるかを担当に聞き、自分で使い始めず、案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 毎晩使用することと当夜の対応を確認待ちにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Every night when I go to sleep. I will ask the person in charge whether I can use it tonight and wait for instructions rather than starting to use it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you use it every night and will wait for confirmation about tonight's arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当へ確認に行ってきます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will go and check with the person in charge. Excuse me.
